data.content:
I sent one dispute, you skipped one, and one is on hold until you find an order ticket. The payout file had 3 refund deductions totaling $69.10.

| Case | Amount | Evidence | Win chance | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UE-9a31 | $24.30 | Moderate. The ticket lists the Honey Drizzle, and the order was picked up 5 minutes after it was ready. | 75% | **Dispute sent**, with your approval. |
| UE-9a47 | $11.80 | Strong. The ticket lists only a Protein Bowl, not the claimed Fruit Bowl. Pickup was 2 minutes after ready. | 85% | **Skipped.** You declined to send the draft, so I won't retry it. |
| UE-9b02 | $33.00 | Weak. There is no order ticket on file, so I can't check the claimed Green Smoothie. | 30% | **Not drafted.** |

- **UE-9a31:** The ticket shows the Honey Drizzle was ordered, but it doesn't prove it was packed. Memory has no Uber Eats history for this pattern. Past DoorDash cases with the same evidence won 2 of 3. The one loss involved a side item that wasn't listed on the ticket. Here the item is on the ticket.
- **UE-9a47:** The ticket shows what was prepared, not what was in the bag, so the draft makes no claim about the bag. Memory has no history for this claim type.
- **UE-9b02:** This is the largest deduction, but its win chance dropped from 55% to 30% without a ticket. **Please find the ticket photo for this order.** If you have it, I can re-run the evidence check.

The next deadline is **2026-12-12**, 28 days away. It applies to all three cases, so you can still send UE-9a47 or UE-9b02 before then. I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`.

When UE-9a31 is decided, tell me the result and I'll record it so future cases learn from it.
